name: Grand Hyatt Manila
short_description: A 461-room Grand Hyatt in Bonifacio Global City with a 57th-floor Grand Club Lounge and panoramic Manila views.
ai_summary: Grand Hyatt Manila occupies one of the tallest buildings in the Philippines in Bonifacio Global City (BGC), Taguig's business and social hub. Guests consistently praise the 57th-floor Grand Club Lounge's panoramic views and the hotel's attentive, English-fluent service, along with a well-regarded breakfast across its six restaurants. BGC itself leans business-district over tourist-strip, with the area's livelier restaurants and nightlife roughly a 7-minute drive away, and a few reviewers note a lengthy check-out process as a rare friction point in an otherwise polished stay.

core_facts.address: 36th Street corner 8th Avenue, Bonifacio Global City, Taguig, Metro Manila 1634, Philippines
elite_benefits: Grand Club Lounge access, on the 57th floor with panoramic city views, for suite guests and World of Hyatt Globalist Elite members
Room upgrades for Explorist and Globalist Elite members, subject to availability, per World of Hyatt program terms
Late check-out until 4pm for Globalist Elite members, subject to availability

pros: 57th-floor Grand Club Lounge with panoramic Manila views
Staff repeatedly described as polite, accommodating, and fluent in English
Six on-site restaurants with a breakfast guests call a huge, delicious selection
Pool, gym, sauna and steam room facilities draw consistent praise
Central BGC location convenient for business and shopping
cons: BGC leans business-district, with livelier restaurants and nightlife about a 7-minute drive away
Breakfast is noted as a bit pricey outside of elite/package inclusions
One reviewer reported a check-out process that took around 40 minutes
research_highlights: The Grand Club Lounge and its panoramic views are repeatedly called a highlight
Service quality -- from lobby to breakfast to housekeeping -- draws consistent praise
Guests booking with World of Hyatt points describe strong value via suite upgrades
research_watchouts: BGC's more business-oriented streets mean the livelier parts of the district are a short drive rather than a walk away
A review noted an unusually long, roughly 40-minute check-out process

faqs.question: Does Grand Hyatt Manila have a club lounge?
faqs.answer: Yes -- the Grand Club Lounge sits on the 57th floor with panoramic views over Manila. Access is included with suite bookings and is also a benefit for World of Hyatt Globalist Elite members, alongside the hotel's separately well-regarded breakfast at its six restaurants.

faqs.question: Is Grand Hyatt Manila within walking distance of BGC's restaurants and nightlife?
faqs.answer: It's in a more business-oriented stretch of BGC, so the district's livelier restaurant and nightlife scene is about a 7-minute drive rather than a walk. The hotel itself still offers six on-site dining options for guests who'd rather stay in.

reviews.title: Review: Sitting on top of the world at Grand Hyatt Manila
reviews.summary: Praises the stunning 57th-floor Grand Club and exemplary service, describing a family stay booked entirely with points that included complimentary suite upgrades and premium dining, with easy access to nearby shopping and entertainment.
